name: CleanedWeb
tagline: Maintained APIs that return structured records from public websites
description: Find and run maintained REST APIs for public websites: job boards, marketplaces, app stores, package registries, research databases and more. find_api and get_api search the catalog and show each API's inputs and record fields; run_api returns records with a record limit; request_source asks for a site that is not listed yet. Remote server with OAuth sign-in in the browser; searching is free and runs are paid per accepted record.
